# Cell: extract and display all figures from the Demattê 2020 PDF with extracted captions
# Requires PyMuPDF (fitz), Pillow, pandas. The script will install if missing.
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import display, Image, Markdown
import pandas as pd

# Run the helper script (it will install dependencies if needed)
import runpy
runpy.run_path('scripts/extract_pdf_figures.py', run_name='__main__')

# Read captions file and display each image with caption
out_dir = Path('extracted_figures')
csv_path = out_dir / 'captions.csv'
if not csv_path.exists():
    print('No captions.csv found. Run the extraction script first.')
else:
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
    for i, row in df.iterrows():
        img_path = Path(row['image'])
        caption = str(row.get('caption', '')).strip()
        if img_path.exists():
            display(Image(filename=str(img_path)))
            if caption:
                display(Markdown('**Caption (extracted):**
' + caption))
            else:
                display(Markdown('*No caption extracted.*'))
        else:
            print('Missing image file:', img_path)
